decisions.reason: As a very new and highly niche marine-lighting offer with limited website prominence, it remains an exploratory option, but the cost of keeping it available is likely low enough that withdrawal in 2019 would be premature.
A dedicated product page and close fit with professional lighting make it sensible to keep this young product on the market while the firm learns more about its demand.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the core capabilities of a large German electrical-equipment manufacturer, so the option value of continued market presence is still high.
Because this is a relaunch of a previously popular designer task light, uncertainty is lower than for a wholly new product and there is little reason to remove it quickly.
